title: Which three distinct third-page visits are most frequently observed immedia
question: Which three distinct third-page visits are most frequently observed immediately after two consecutive visits to the '/detail' page, and how many times does each third-page visit occur?

prediction.sql:
WITH visits AS (
  SELECT session, stamp, path,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp) AS rn
  FROM activity_log
)
SELECT v3.path AS third_page, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM visits v1
JOIN visits v2 ON v1.session = v2.session AND v2.rn = v1.rn + 1
JOIN visits v3 ON v2.session = v3.session AND v3.rn = v2.rn + 1
WHERE v1.path = '/detail' AND v2.path = '/detail'
GROUP BY v3.path
ORDER BY cnt DESC, v3.path
LIMIT 3
